description: Assumes cybercrime volume remains identical to the immediately preceding year.
Predicts the arithmetic mean of the preceding two years.
Ordinary Least Squares regression on raw historical counts.
Linear regression with L2 regularization penalty (alpha=1.0).
Linear regression on log1p counts with exponential back-transformation.
Single decision tree with constrained depth (max_depth=3) to prevent overfitting.
Random forest ensemble of 100 shallow trees (max_depth=3, random_state=42).
